title: Scaffold Record
description:
What the scaffolding stage created, or found already created: the game repository made from web-game-template, the template revision it came from, and the game.config.yaml written from tech_plan.repo_params.

Scaffolding is the one stage with an outside side effect that must not happen twice, so the record states whether the repository was created by this execution or reused. A re-run that finds the repository it made before records `reused`, never a second repository.

name.description: One directory entry: never . or .., which would make a consumer act on the checkouts directory or its parent.

template.description: The web-game-template revision the repository was generated from.

repository.description: owner/name for source github; the local template path, relative to the Factory root where possible, for source local.

commit_sha.description: The template revision the project's tree holds: the Factory's pinned web-game-template commit.

generated_from_sha.description: source github: the tip of the template's default branch when GitHub generated the repository, which need not be the pinned commit.

pin_commit.description: source github: the local commit that brought a repository generated from another revision to commit_sha. Absent when it was generated at the pin.

source.description: github: generated from the template repository on GitHub. local: cloned from a local checkout of the template at commit_sha, with no remote and no network - what offline and golden-regression runs use. Absent means github (records written before this field existed).

game_config.description: The game.config.yaml written into the repository.

engine.description: The engine game.config.yaml selects, as read back from the project after it was written.

commit_sha.description: The commit that wrote game.config.yaml from tech_plan.repo_params.game_config, or that an earlier execution of the same key made. Absent when the file already matched the plan and nothing was committed.

pushed.description: Whether commit_sha has been pushed. Scaffolding never pushes - pushing is outward-facing - so this is false whenever commit_sha is set: the commit exists only in the local project until someone pushes it.

outcome.description: created: this execution made the repository. reused: it already existed from an earlier execution and was verified rather than recreated.

idempotency_key.description: The key the side effect was performed under, so a later execution can find it.
